name: BizBuySell
focus: Main Street + lower-middle-market SMBs and franchises
notes: Largest US marketplace (CoStar). Akamai/Cloudflare protection - needs real browser session; direct fetch returns 403.

name: BizQuest
notes: CoStar-owned sister site to BizBuySell; similar stack and inventory overlap.

name: BusinessesForSale.com
notes: Large international marketplace; US filter available.

name: BusinessBroker.net
notes: Broker-fed listing portal; listing cards are JS-rendered (use browser mode).

name: DealStream
notes: Marketplace + professional network; some content behind login.

name: LoopNet
notes: CoStar-owned; strong anti-bot. Business-for-sale section overlaps BizBuySell.

name: Baton Market
notes: Modern tech-driven marketplace (also at batonmarket.com). Verified financials; some detail NDA-gated. Off-market section. Likely a client-rendered SPA - needs JS rendering to scrape.

name: GlobalBX
notes: Free marketplace; older site, generally scrapeable.

name: BizBen
notes: California-focused; high-value if CA is a target geography.

name: Axial
notes: Lower-mid-market deal sourcing network; largely gated/membership.

name: Acquire.com
notes: Formerly MicroAcquire. Buyer access requires free account; online businesses only.

name: Flippa
column12: Online-business marketplace; outside core SMB scope but high volume.

name: Sunbelt Business Brokers
column11: Largest broker franchise network by offices. Network site aggregates office listings.

name: Transworld Business Advisors
notes: Large franchise network (United Franchise Group). Listing grid is a JS SPA (GorillaDash); use browser/stealth mode.

name: Murphy Business
notes: National franchise network. Listings page is JS-rendered (use browser mode).

name: First Choice Business Brokers
notes: One of the largest by transaction volume.

name: Synergy Business Brokers
notes: Higher deal sizes than typical Main Street networks.

name: Empire Flippers
notes: Curated online-business marketplace; listings partly gated.

name: Sunbelt (regional sites)
notes: Individual Sunbelt offices also run local listing sites; network search covers most.

name: USBizSale
notes: Smaller general marketplace - verify activity before scraping.
